units.text: The claim states China's July 2024 population estimate as 1,408,975,000, but both cited sources report the 2024 population as 1,408,280,000, contradicting the exact figure. The sources do not provide a specific July 2024 monthly figure; they give end-of-2024 totals.

citations.title: China's newborns rise in 2024, first time in years

judgement.reason: The passages support that both sources report 1,408,280,000 as an end-of-2024 total and do not provide a July 2024 monthly figure, but they do not mention the claim's alleged July 2024 estimate of 1,408,975,000.
